question: Which of the following holy days in Christianity is a mourning day?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Good Friday**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Good Friday** is observed by Christians as a day of mourning and reflection on the crucifixion of Jesus Christ.
 
• It is part of the Holy Week, which also includes Palm Sunday, Maundy Thursday, and Easter Sunday.
